Players who do not play or are not assigned a fantasy-point value by Sleeper are treated as scoring 0 fantasy points. Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Reception: +1.

Kicking

Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.

Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
